> [!IMPORTANT]
> v1.2.2 fixes a critical crash when starting on-device podcast subtitle recognition on newer ARMv9 devices (such as Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 phones). Updating immediately is recommended.
>
> v1.2.2 修复了在新款 ARMv9 设备（如骁龙 8 Elite Gen 5 机型）上启动播客端侧字幕识别时立即闪退的重大问题，建议立即升级。

## Changes

- Fix an immediate crash when starting on-device podcast subtitle recognition on newer ARMv9 devices (such as Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 phones).

Requires Android 8.0 or newer and an ARM64 device.
